name: signature-fx-a
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual production transparent PIXEL GAME EFFECT animation atlas. EXACTLY 4 columns and 8 equal rows, no borders no gaps except transparent margins in each equal cell. Every ROW is one effect animated across its FOUR cells left-to-right (windup, active, follow-through, fading). Eight rows from top to bottom: 1: Socrates wooden walking staff sweeping sideways; 2: Nietzsche heavy short-handled philosopher hammer slamming downward; 3: Plato exactly THREE small flying books in a fan formation; 4: Confucius bamboo manuscript and calligraphy stroke; 5: Buddhist lotus petals opening in a small ring; 6: Kant pocket-watch hands ticking through a quarter turn; 7: Occam razor cutting a short neat arc; 8: Lacan small hand mirror tilting and reflecting a tiny square. Only objects and their tiny restrained motion traces, no hands, no characters, no scenery, no labels, no text. Same center and scale in each frame, all objects inside their equal cells. Match simple chunky 24-32 native pixel object art enlarged, limited pastel colors, crisp square pixels, dark muted plum outlines. No large auras, no bright glows, no white explosions. Genuine transparent alpha background. Tall 1:2 overall atlas, effects suitable for tiny cute philosopher defenders, motifs readable at 40 pixels.
